items.title: Sidney Desvigne Interview, 1958-08-18
items.q: You had to change it and get a gold horn because the band was Allie's gold band.

ctx.x: He wouldn't say nothing to me.

Wouldn't tell me all he do, right here he lives, and I knock on the door. It was George Foster's wife came in. So he goes back in the kitchen and talks and tells me what. I told him all these fellas, it's funny actually. He said, well I'll tell you. Be careful, he says. So... You made a mistake of one thing that you done while they don't like you. By taking DejVe with you and leaving Bob Schauffer going to organize the band. You see? They say, watch these guys who's not allowed to do your thing. He said, alright.…
That's right. The gold band. I had to get a gold trumpet.
